title: Online Shopping Privacy Request Letter Template
metaDescription: Free template to request your personal data from online retailers. Protect your shopping privacy and understand how stores use your information.
description: A comprehensive letter template to request information about how online retailers collect, use, and share your personal shopping data. Essential for protecting your privacy and understanding dynamic pricing practices.

sections.heading: Header Information
sections.content:
[Your Name]
[Your Address]
[City, State, ZIP Code]
[Your Email]
[Your Phone Number]

[Date]

[Company Name]
Privacy Officer / Data Protection Officer
[Company Address]
[City, State, ZIP Code]

sections.heading: Subject and Introduction
sections.content:
Subject: Data Access Request Under Privacy Laws

Dear Privacy Officer,

I am writing to request access to my personal data that your company has collected about me as a customer. As a consumer, I have the right to understand what information you collect, how it's used, and with whom it's shared. My account email is [YOUR_EMAIL] and I have been a customer since approximately [DATE].

sections.heading: Specific Data Categories Requested
sections.content:
Please provide me with the following information about my personal data:

• All personal information collected (name, address, phone, email, payment details)
• Complete purchase history and browsing behavior data
• Any behavioral profiling or customer segmentation categories
• Price personalization or dynamic pricing algorithms applied to my account
• Third-party companies with whom my data has been shared
• Data collected through cookies, tracking pixels, and similar technologies
• Any data purchased from data brokers or obtained from external sources

sections.heading: Privacy Rights Request
sections.content:
Under applicable privacy laws (CCPA, GDPR, or similar state regulations), I am requesting:

1. A copy of all personal data you have collected about me
2. Information about the sources of this data
3. The business purposes for collecting and using my information
4. Categories of third parties with whom you share my data
5. Details about any automated decision-making or profiling
6. Information about data retention periods

I would also like to opt out of the sale or sharing of my personal information for advertising purposes.

sections.heading: Identity Verification
sections.content:
To verify my identity, I am providing the following information:

• Account email: [YOUR_EMAIL]
• Phone number associated with account: [PHONE_NUMBER]
• Recent order number (if applicable): [ORDER_NUMBER]
• Billing address on file: [BILLING_ADDRESS]

If you need additional verification, please contact me at the email address provided above.

sections.heading: Response Timeline and Format
sections.content:
Please respond to this request within 45 days as required by law. I would prefer to receive this information in electronic format (PDF or CSV files) sent to my email address. If you cannot fulfill this request or need additional information, please explain the specific reasons and provide information about my right to appeal.

I also request that you provide this information free of charge, as this is my first request of this nature.

sections.heading: Closing
sections.content:
Thank you for your attention to this matter. I look forward to your prompt response and to better understanding how my personal information is being used. If you have any questions about this request, please contact me at [YOUR_EMAIL] or [YOUR_PHONE].

Sincerely,
[Your Signature]
[Your Printed Name]
